characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_3: ¿Hice algo mal? Has estado actuando distinto.$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_4: ¿Alguna vez te preguntas qué más hay afuera?$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_5: Antes eras más romátinco... ¿qué pasó?$s#$e#Yo sé que ya no soy tan joven... ¿por eso te casaste conmigo?$^Antes eras más romátinca... ¿qué pasó?$s#$e#Yo sé que ya no soy tan joven... ¿por eso te casaste conmigo?$a
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_6: Tenemos una vida bien corta y rápida... ¿esta es la mejor forma de vivirla?$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_7: Antes era tu amorcito... ahora parece que solo me aguantas cuando hago una once.$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_8: Estás muy frío conmigo de hace un tiempo...$s^Estás muy fría conmigo de hace un tiempo...
characters.dialogue.marriage.bad_9: Me pregunto si pude haberlo hecho mejor.$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_1: Este clima está mucho mejor después de tanto calor.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_15: ¿Ya sabes qué vas a poner en la Exposición Agrícola mañana?
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_26: ¿Vamos a ir a la Víspera de los Espíritus mañana en la noche?
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_8: El iniverno ya está viniendo. Tenemos que hacerle mantenimiento al calefont, comprar parafina para la estufa, revisar el aislamiento general y si hay goteras.#$e#Pero tranqui, todo eso lo veo yo.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_abigai: Vamos a cultivar zapallos ente año, ¿cierto?.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_elliot: Ah... El otoño. El cálido sol vaga bajo por el cielo, lanzando largas sombras sobre los danzantes campos dorados.#$e#Es un hermosa época, ¿no crees?
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_emily: ¡Me tomé un batido de superalimento en la mañana y me siento en aaah-rmonía!$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_haley: Tengo ganas de torta.#$e#Pero no de cualquiera... tiene que ser rosada.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_harvey: Creo que ire por un vino.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_leah: Respira hondo... ¿alcanzai a oler? Indica que es época de setas.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_maru: Qué bueno que todavía trabajo en la clínica... Es bien importante para la comunidad.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_penny: Se siente tan pacífico aquí afuera en la granja. Nunca pude apreciar así la naturaleza viviendo en el pueblo.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_sam: A veces pienso qué pasa en el resto del mundo. Estamos bien aislados acá.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_sebast: Mi mamá siempre hacía Crema de Zapallo cuando era otoño.
characters.dialogue.marriage.fall_shane: Parece que hay otro tipo de hongo más saliendo de mi mini-refri.#$e#Ah, weno, cosa del otoño, ¿o no?
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_0: Todavía me cuesta creer que estemos casados...$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_1: La verdad que siempre tuve la sensación de que íbamos a terminar juntos un día.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_2: ¿Te ha gustado hasta ahora la vida de casados, @?#$e#A mí sí.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_3: Oh, ¡estás muy guapo hoy día!$l^Ufff, estás preciosa hoy día.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_4: Esta casa es mi hogar ahora... Estoy feliz aquí.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_5: Estaba mirando mi amuleto de matrimonio... La conchita está perfecta. ¡Te debió costar demasiada plata!$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_6: ¡Anda con cuidado! A veces me da miedo que caigas en un hoyo en las cuevas.
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_7: ¿@? Te quería decir que te doy gracias por toda la pega que haces por nuestra casa.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_8: Tranqui, yo estoy bien... Yo sé que tienes que hacer hartas cosas fuera de la casa. ¡Yo puedo estar a solas un rato!$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.good_9: Oh, no es que sea fome... solo estoy disfrutando lo que tenemos acá.#$e#Es una vida simple, pero me gusta.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.indoor_day_: Buenos días ~<$h#$e#¿Listo para partir el día? Yo sí.$h^Buenos días ~<$h#$e#¿Lista para partir el día? Yo sí.
¡Hola, amorcito! Huele rico, ¿cierto? ¡Te hice desayuno! [194 195 210 211 216]#$e#Hay que tomar un buen desayunito para aguantar el día.
¿Dormiste bien?#$e#Yo tengo que hacer unas cosas por aquí.

¿Has tenido sueños últimamente?#$e#Yo sí, pero solo me acuerdo que tenía algo que ver con %noun %adj. Extrañísimo.$s#$e#Jeje. No es que los sueños signifiquen algo... ¿o sí?$l#$e#Bueno, no podemos estar leseando todo el día con esto. ¡Tienes pega que hacer!
Buenos días, amor. Otro día de tareas de granja, ¿eh?#$e#Te voy a estar apoyando. <$h
Siempre hay algo nuevo en la granja... Me encanta.
¡El sol 'ta brillando y yo me 'toy llenando de energía! ¡Ándate con cuida'o! Jeje.$h
He estado usando un diario desde que vivimos juntos. Ahora que por fin tengo una vida, tengo mucho para escribir.$h#$e#Quiero asegurarme de siempre remembrar estos años.
Al proveer productos frescos y saludables a la comunidad, ¡estamos haciendo un excelente servicio!
Siempre me siento bien cuando hay sol.$h
El cielo se ve bello hoy... ¡muy limpio!#$e#De ahora en adelante, voy a ir a la clínica solo cuando tenga citas. Si no, ¡siempre puedo trabajar desde la casa!
Ojalá poder ayudarte con la granja, pero no puedo salir al sol, po'...
¿Te molesta si le pongo estilo arquitectónico a las maderas de por aquí? ¡Me pican las manos de formón!
Si quieres hablar sobre cómo maximizar la producción de cultivos o cualquier cosa... ¡aquí estoy!
Este lugar es demasiado grande comparado con la casa rodante, me sobrepasa... ¡de buena manera, eso sí!
Tengo hartas cosas que quiero terminar hoy día... En volá mejor veo la tele.
Bue, este lugar obviamente le da una paliza a mi pieza en el sótano, ¿sí o no?$h
Hay como algo especial en el aire... *olisquea*... ¿Qué es? Oh...#$b#Es un suflé que me metí al bolsillo la otra vez. Como hace dos semanas. *Mastica*
characters.dialogue.marriage.indoor_nigh: Did you get everything done today, @?#$e#I did some house chores... but now I'm so tired.#$e#I'm ready for bed whenever you are.$h
Wow, you look like you did a lot of work today.#$e#Now you should just relax and kick back for the night.$h
I'm glad you're home.#$e#I get kind of scared alone at night.$s^I get lonely at night...$s#$e#...$h
Are you done with your work for the day? I'm ready to have some fun.$h#$e#But if you're tired I understand.
*phew*! I just finished my chores. Now we can spend some time together.$h#$e#So, tell me about your day.$l#$e#...$h
Are you ready for bed soon? I turned on the electric blanket for us...$l
My arms feel a little restless... How about a nice, deep massage?$l^I feel exhausted... That's a good sign! It means I worked hard enough today.$h

#$c .5#You always smell so good after a day of hard work. It's your natural musk!^You smell sweet, my dear. Like a honeycomb drifting on a pool of spice tea.#$e#Come here, let me massage your back. You look tense.$l^You smell sweet, my dear. Like a cinnamon leaf floating in the summer breeze.
It's a very cozy house... I like it.
You look like you've been working hard, dear. Let me help you de-stress.$l
You look like you could use a good massage tonight.$l#$e#Doctor's orders... It's good for the circulation!
Hi, @. Welcome home. You look like you've been working hard out there!$h
It's so quiet and peaceful in the evening. Nothing to distract you from the experience of living.
You look like you're ready for bed, @. Should I lull you to sleep with the technical details of my latest project?$h#$e#*yawn*... To be honest, I'm kind of sleepy too.
Hi there, honey. Ready to spend a quiet evening at home?
#$c .5#I wonder if the moon is visible tonight?#$e#So, did you get everything done on the farm today? If you didn't I won't be mad!
#$c .5#I may be a reclusive guy, but I'm always happy when you're around.$h#$e#Hi, @. Good to see you. It's comforting when you're around.$h
How was your day? Mine actually went pretty well.
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobleave_ha: I have to go into the clinic today. Have a nice day, okay?
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobleave_ma: I have to leave for work soon. I'll see you tonight. I'll be thinking of you!$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobleave_pe: I have to go into town today. Don't work too hard, and eat something good for lunch!$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobreturn_h: #$c .5#Hi, honey. How was your day?#$e#*Phew*... I'm exhausted...$s#$e#My patients are still healthy, so it was a good day.
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobreturn_m: #$c .5#Well, it was just another boring day at the clinic.#$e#Hey. Did you have a more exciting day than me? I hope so.#$e#$c .5#Well, it's time to kick back and relax. Did you leave me any dinner?#$e#I'm just looking forward to bed-time.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.jobreturn_p: #$c .5#Good evening. My day was fine, thanks! How was yours?$h#$e#Jas and Vincent weren't behaving very well today. I'm still all wound up...
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_0: I hope you'll still like me when I'm old and gray.$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_1: Do you think your grandpa would be proud of the work we've done?
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_2: Taking a break? I guess being a farmer is easier than I thought...
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_3: If you go into town, make sure and say hi to everyone for me.
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_4: I'll do the laundry tomorrow morning before you get up... that way you won't have any down-time.
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_5: Are we doing okay on money, @?
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_6: I wonder what everyone in town is doing today?
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_7: I don't really feel like doing anything today.
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_8: No matter how much I clean, the house keeps getting dirty again.#$e#I guess farms can be kind of dirty.
characters.dialogue.marriage.neutral_9: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives?
characters.dialogue.marriage.nobed_0: Where am I supposed to sleep...?$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.nobed_1: I wasn't able to sleep well last night...$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.nobed_2: I had to sleep on the floor last night...$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.nobed_3: Did something happen to our bed...?$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.onekid_0: Have you spent any time with %kid1 today?
characters.dialogue.marriage.onekid_1: I wonder if %kid1 will grow up to be a farmer like you?
characters.dialogue.marriage.onekid_2: Don't worry, I'll feed %kid1 today. You can just focus on running the farm.
characters.dialogue.marriage.onekid_3: Life's a lot different now that we have a child.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_0: It's a beautiful day today, isn't it?$h#$e#Days like this make work a little more pleasant.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_1: I'm just going to relax and inspect the farm today, okay?#$e#It's just such a nice-looking area.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_2: Hi, honey! If I knew more about farm work I'd help you out more. Sorry!#$e#I'll be thinking of you.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_3: I'm just going to do some dusting over here. That should help you out, right?#$e#*phew*... it's hot out here.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_4: Don't overwork yourself, dear.#$e#Make sure and take a break every now and then, or get something to eat.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_abi: I'm just going to hang out here, okay?#$e#There's a lot of interesting bugs and things out here. *chuckle*$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_ale: I'm going to get a bunch of exercise today! Haha! I love living on a farm.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_ell: Today, I'm going to continue writing my new novel. What better place than our wonderful farm?$h#$e#This is perfect.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_emi: You're doing great work, @. Keep it up.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_hal: Looks like a good day to work on my tan, don't you think, sweetheart?$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_har: This is so much nicer than being cooped up in the clinic all day.$l#$e#I love watching you on the farm... hehe
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_kro: On a day like this, I can enjoy the outdoors with you. This is really nice!$h#$b#Just let me know if you see anyone coming, so I can hide.$u
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_lea: Wow, this is great! I'm really starting to enjoy life on the farm, @.$h#$e#This is the life I've always dreamed of.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_mar: I like being out here. It's a good place to think about new inventions.$h#$e#I'm still hoping to come up with something to help you out in your work.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_pen: I'm really happy on our little farm, @.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_sam: Hey, look at those puffy clouds in the sky, honey!$h#$e#I'm going to watch those for a while, if you don't mind.
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_seb: This is so different from my old life, but I'm really starting to like it.$h#$e#I feel like I really belong here.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.outdoor_sha: I dunno if my lungs can handle this freshness. I'm still used to JojaAir.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_0: It's raining outside. Make sure you don't catch cold, dear.#$e#Stay indoors as much as possible.$h#$e#I worry about you sometimes!
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_1: It's raining! That means we don't have to water the crops today.$h#$e#Nature can be a big help sometimes.#$e#Have you fed the animals yet, honey?
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_2: Good morning! I woke up early from the sound of the rain and made you some breakfast. [194 195 210 211 216]  #$e#Stay warm and don't work too hard. I want you to stay healthy.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_3: What's on your agenda today, dear?#$e#I don't want to go outside in this weather... I'll just do some things around the house.#$e#Maybe I'll make something hot for dinner.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_a: The countryside looks more interesting on a day like this, don't you think?
Hmm... I guess I'll have to do push-ups and sit-ups indoors today.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_e: The rain makes me think of my old life by the ocean.#$e#Change is part of life. That's okay.
I know you pride yourself on your work, but don't overdo it today. Okay, honey?$u
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_h: Hmmph. If this weather keeps up I'll get too pale.$s
Make sure you stay dry today, dear. I don't want you to become hypothermic.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_k: Ah, it's more humid today with the rain... I feel a lot more comfortable.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_l: Might want to do some fishing or mining today, huh?
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_m: Despite all the technology we have, a rainy day is still the best tool for watering crops.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_p: I think I might do some baking today.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_day_s: I might spend some time today fixing any leaks in the roof or the windows.
I got up just before dawn and took a walk around the farm. It's really peaceful at that hour.
The roof's leaking? Ah well... a little mold never hurt anyone.
characters.dialogue.marriage.rainy_night: The rain makes it feel like we're all alone.$l#$e#I'm cold... Aren't you ready to tuck into bed?$l
Make sure you change into something warm. I don't want you to get sick.#$e#Can you hear the rain pattering on the roof, @?
Ah...The soothing sound of rain overhead... I'm going to sleep well tonight.$h
The rain makes our home seem so cozy.$h^It's nights like this I'm glad we have a quality roof.
I made some soup for dinner. [199 218 219 727 730]$h#$e#You need something hot on a day like this!$h
I'm glad you're home... It's a good night to stay inside.
I'm ready to hop into bed whenever you are. The sound of rain will put us right to sleep.
Grandma always used to make hot stew on nights like this.$h
Sit down, relax! You've got to be tired after trudging through the mud all day.
Certain spirits only appear in the rain. Maybe you've heard their cries?
Hi, honey. I'm so glad you're home. I was starting to get kind of lonely.$l
Hi. It's good to see you.$h#$e#I spent the day skimming through some medical journals.
The sound of the rain reminds me of the sewers... it's comforting.#$e#The sewers were my refuge... I felt safe there. But don't worry... I feel the same way about my new home, too.
How was your day today, dear? Muddy?
Were you able to accomplish much today, hun?#$e#I tried to fix up some things around the house... you know, just little stuff.
Oh... the smell? I tried to do some baking... It didn't work out too well.$s
Vincent called. He said he misses me and also to tell you hi.$h
I'll never grow tired of the rain... especially out here in the countryside.
I just got off the phone with Jas and Marnie. They seem to be having a pretty good time without me.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spouseroom_: #$c .5#I got up a little before you and fed David Jr. He's very active this morning.#$e#I hope you don't mind the guinea pig smell.
#$c .5#Don't ever let me get lazy. I want to stay in good shape for you!#$e#There's lots of room here to do my exercises. I'm making more progress than ever!
#$c .5#I think I might do some writing today.#$e#Will you be okay without my help?
I'm going to spend some time with the parrot today. It breaks my heart that he'll never fly again.$u
#$c .5#Go ahead and start your day, honey. I'm just putting on my make-up.#$e#Have any plans for the day?
#$c .5#No air-traffic this morning, honey. But it's still fun to break out the equipment now and then.#$e#I'm working on a new model plane. It's so much more relaxing here than in my old apartment.
#$c .5#One of these days I'll have to do your portrait.#$e#The view from this window is inspiring, don't you think?
#$c .5#I got up early to do a little star-gazing.#$e#I hope you don't mind if I spend some time on my projects today, honey.
#$c .5#I always wanted my very own library. This is so charming.$h#$e#I like to do a little reading first thing in the morning. It gets my brain into gear.
#$c .5#The old guitar... I don't have as much drive to play it anymore. That's fine.#$e#What's on your agenda today?
#$c .5#I'm debating whether I should work or just read comics all day.#$e#Hey, do we have any pizza in the freezer? I'm hungry.
#$c .5#Beer or cider? Sometimes life can be challenging.#$e#Hi, @. I'll just hang out in here today and uh... maybe sweep the floor a little bit or something.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_1: Well, a new year has arrived. Do you have a plan for what you want to accomplish this year?#$e#I feel pretty hopeful.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_23: I hope you've been practicing your moves... tomorrow is the flower dance!
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_8: Now that winter's over, we've got lots of productive weather to look forward to.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_abig: I may like the colder seasons, but by the end I'm always glad to see spring arrive.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_elli: I'm looking forward to a beautiful year on %farm farm.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_hale: Aren't you glad winter's over, honey? Things seem more hopeful now.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_harv: Let's plant some healthy vegetables this spring.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_leah: Don't forget to look for wild horseradish, leeks and dandelions while you're out there!
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_maru: I'm feeling excited for a new year of farming, @!$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_penn: I'm so happy to see some greenery after that long white winter.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_sam: *sniff* ... My doze is stubbed up... allergies.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_seba: Wow, my skin is pale... I guess I'd better help you with some farm work this season.
characters.dialogue.marriage.spring_shan: Maybe I'll learn a new skill this year...
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_1: Make sure you don't get a heat stroke, dear.#$e#Drink plenty of water and don't overwork yourself.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_15: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_8: Sorry if I smell... I was sweating all night in the heat.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_abig: Oh man... I could go for some chocolate cake.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_alex: I always have the most energy in the summer.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_elli: One of the main things I miss about the ocean is the fresh fish.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_emil: Phew! It's hot but it feels great, doesn't it?#$e#Maybe we'll see some wild parrots today.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_hale: You must know by now that summer is my favorite season.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_harv: Make sure you don't get sunburnt, honey... That can really damage your skin.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_leah: Nothing pairs so well with summer like a nice sweet wine. Don't you think, honey?
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_maru: It's a good time of year to do some stargazing.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_penn: Are you growing any melons this summer?
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_sam: Summer always makes me want to eat more barbecue.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_seba: I'm going to stay inside as much as possible this summer.
characters.dialogue.marriage.summer_shan: What's on my agenda today... hmmm... #$e#I think I see some spicy pretzel snacks and a couple of 'cold boys' on the horizon.
characters.dialogue.marriage.twokids_0: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their breakfast. They were hungry!
characters.dialogue.marriage.twokids_1: We have to make sure and give %kid1 a lot of attention now that we have %kid2. We don't want any jealousy between them.
characters.dialogue.marriage.twokids_2: You know, I think %kid2 has your nose.
characters.dialogue.marriage.twokids_3: A nice house, two wonderful kids, and a beautiful plot of land. What's left?
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_1: Brrr.... It's cold. I guess winter has arrived.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_28: Thanks for a great year, @. I'm excited to tackle next year together.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_7: Are you going to enter the fishing contest tomorrow?
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_abig: Remember when we played that 'Prairie King' game together, in my room? Those were good times.$h
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_alex: I hope my grandparents are doing okay. They used to rely on my help quite a bit. You know, with lifting heavy objects or whatever.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_elli: I think I might do some writing this winter. There's not much else to do, anyway.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_emil: Whoops, my hair is frozen solid again.$s
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_hale: I was just thinking about the time you helped me open a jar of pickles.$h#$e#We've come a long way since then.$l
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_harv: Winter is flu season, so work is probably going to be a lot more stressful. Sorry in advance if I'm grouchy.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_leah: I always start craving salad in the winter... Inconvenient, I know.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_maru: Spring is coming soon. I'm really looking forward to having rhubarb pie.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_penn: I'm going to do a lot of reading this winter.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_sam: I've given up on being a musician. I'm a family man now!
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_seba: I wonder what Sam's up to? We used to be really good friends.
characters.dialogue.marriage.winter_shan: There's a wide, wide world out there... but I'd rather stay in my room.
